title: CatalogueSkillMember

name.description: The member's name by the member-naming rule, as the environment's reader names it.

description.description: What the member does, in a sentence written for the card.

invocation.description: How a member is invoked: model+slash (the model may choose it, and a person may type /name), or slash-only (its frontmatter sets disable-model-invocation: true, so only /name invokes it).

description: A member of a skills entry's folder as its card lists it: its name, a sentence on what it does, and its invocation.
